createPagePost.description: Compose and publish a post on a Facebook Page (or profile) through the logged-in session: open the page, open the Create post dialog, type the text, attach media files, click Post, then reload the page and confirm the text is in the feed.

pageUrl.description: Page or profile URL whose composer to use, e.g. https://www.facebook.com/dwarvesf/. The logged-in account must manage it.

text.description: Post body. Newlines are fine. Markdown backticks stay literal.

media.description: Absolute file paths to attach. Images, gif, and video are accepted by the composer's file input.

returns.description: {posted: true, url} on success (url is null when the virtualized feed hides the permalink); {posted: false, reason} on refusal (logged out, composer did not open, no Post button, text missing after reload).

listPageReels.description: List every reel id on a Facebook Page's reels tab through the logged-in session. Opens the URL in a background tab (never brought to front), forces the hidden tab to lazy-load, scrolls with wheel events until the count stops growing, then closes the tab. Use it to feed a whole channel into a transcription step.

maxRounds.description: Upper bound on scroll rounds. Default 120.

stallRounds.description: Stop after this many rounds with an unchanged count. Default 10.

settleMs.description: Wait after each scroll, in ms. Default 2000.

returns.description: {ids, urls, count, rounds, stalled} on success (urls are https://www.facebook.com/reel/<id>/; stalled is true when the loop ended on the unchanged-count rule, false when it hit maxRounds); {ids: [], reason} when logged out or no reels.

listPageFeed.description: Read a Facebook Page's feed through the logged-in session: per post the id (reel/pcb/photo), url, type (reel, video, album, photo, text), first 600 chars of caption, posted date (hover tooltip, may be empty for some cards), reactions (sum of the per-type labels), comments, shares, Messenger Send-message bar, and reel duration. Opens the Page in a background tab, scrolls in small wheel bursts, hovers each timestamp in view to read its date, merges the virtualized cards, closes the tab. Side effect: moves the virtual pointer inside that background tab only.

maxPosts.description: Stop after this many posts. Default 40.

maxRounds.description: Upper bound on scroll rounds. Default 60.

stallRounds.description: Stop after this many rounds with no new post. Default 6.

settleMs.description: Wait after each scroll round, in ms. Default 1800.

returns.description: {posts: [{id, url, type, text, posted, reactions, comments, shares, messenger, duration}], count, rounds, stalled} on success; {posts: [], reason} when logged out or empty. posted is e.g. 'Saturday, November 14, 2026 at 7:31 PM' or ''.

listPageReelViews.description: List reel ids with the view count printed on each Reels-tab tile ('615', '11K', '1.3K', parsed to numbers). Same background-tab and scroll recipe as listPageReels, capped by maxReels so a routine run reads only the newest tiles.

maxReels.description: Stop after this many tiles. Default 60.

maxRounds.description: Upper bound on scroll rounds. Default 40.

stallRounds.description: Stop after this many rounds with no new tile. Default 6.

returns.description: {reels: [{id, url, views}], count, rounds} on success (views is a rounded number, null when the tile shows none); {reels: [], reason} when logged out or empty.
